note: Reference book profiles for the Step 0 engine decision (scripts/lib/engine-fit.js analyzeBookProfile). Agents fill a new book's profile by comparing it with these; scripts/test-engine-fit.js asserts each still yields `expect`. Add a row when a book's outcome (mute test / retention) teaches something.

rubric.world: real-historical = the book is ABOUT real events/people (biography, history, true crime, memoir) · period = invented story in a past world whose look matters (before ~1950) · contemporary = invented story, roughly the last 70 years · speculative = sci-fi/fantasy/dystopia · ideas = argument/advice/philosophy without a story world
rubric.realPeople: true only when specific real people/events are the SUBJECT. A novel with a real backdrop (WWII) = false + world period
rubric.format: story = told as a story · argument = ideas/advice/analysis · mixed = both carry the book
rubric.violence: central = the climax or most of mustSee is death/gore/violence · some = present, but the key images are not violent · none
rubric.minorHarm: true when abuse/harm of a child is central to the book (policy: never depicted, photoreal excluded)
rubric.mustSee: 3-5 CONCRETE things the viewer must see for the summary to work (places, people, objects, events)

examples.why: contemporary cast staged in Antidote; the teenagers' deaths in the fire are refused by Flux. Measured: 0/30 wrong, image adds 70%.
